summary: The CF4 weighted-least-squares estimator admits exact, physically legitimate passive-basis rotation/axis-permutation, linear-response, quadratic-form, and flow-plus-monopole metamorphic relations. The current B projector admits only an implementation-level odd index-reflection identity. It cannot yet support a physical B-parity pass: the harmonic parity convention is not specified, sigma_2M_history is unused, and a direct fixture contradicts the documented unconditional axisymmetric-zero invariant. PR-172 must therefore fail closed until the B relation is narrowed and the axisymmetric contract is repaired or explicitly conditioned on an upstream-consistent zero B tower. Any eventual pass is C1 software/model self-consistency only.

controlling_assumptions: CF4 directions n_i and positions p_i are Euclidean polar vectors in one common orthonormal basis; radial velocities, weights, and reported uncertainties are scalars under a passive basis change.
The CF4 cosmic-variance kernel is isotropic in the sense implemented by cosmic_variance_M: its scalar functions depend only on separation magnitude and enter through dot products.
The flow-plus-monopole design X=[N,1] has full column rank; a rank-deficient fixture is an expected hard error, not a metamorphic failure.

Amplitude scaling holds with geometry, weights, sig_v, and the assessed covariance fixed. For an additive injection on a nonzero baseline, the relation applies to the baseline-subtracted estimator contrast.
For the B projector, eta is conformal time, k_norm*Delta_eta is dimensionless, visibility_history*deta is dimensionless, and the five channels are ordered m=-2,-1,0,+1,+2 as the source states.

No physical spatial-parity verdict is available until the repository freezes the complex-versus-real harmonic basis, phase/reality convention, active versus passive transformation, and transformation of every B, E, sigma, chart, and wavevector input.

conventions.metric_signature: not used by these two numerical surfaces; repository default (-,+,+,+) retained
conventions.cf4_units: n dimensionless; v, bulk-flow coefficients, and monopole in km/s; coefficient covariance in (km/s)^2; Mahalanobis chi2 dimensionless
conventions.cf4_frame: one common orthonormal coordinate basis; the tested O action is a passive basis change, not rotation of a catalogue against a fixed survey mask
conventions.b_mode_basis: source only states real-valued m=-2..2 channels; a physical harmonic parity convention is absent and is a blocker
conventions.claim_ceiling: C1 estimator symmetry-consistency mechanics; never matched-null, covariance-model, observational, transfer, geometry, or family validation

exact_relations.statement: Let X=[N,1], A=X^T W X, beta=A^-1 X^T W v. For O in SO(3), set N'=N O^T and p'=p O^T while v,w,sig_v stay fixed, and T=diag(O,1). Then X'=X T^T, beta'=T beta, C_noise'=T C_noise T^T, C_cv'=T C_cv T^T, and C_full'=T C_full T^T. Hence ||B||, B^T C_B^-1 B, its tail probability, and its reported sigma are invariant. For the flow-only estimator use T=O.
exact_relations.decisive_falsifier: Any condition-aware residual above the preregistered numerical tolerance in beta'-T beta or C'-T C T^T, or any drift in amplitude/Mahalanobis chi2, when n and pos_hmpc are transformed together. Rotating n alone is an invalid fixture because it changes the covariance geometry.
exact_relations.current_probe: PASS: a non-coordinate proper rotation gave maximum residuals 1.42e-14 in coefficients, 3.64e-12 in noise covariance, and 7.28e-11 in cosmic-variance covariance.

exact_relations.statement: A coordinate-axis permutation P is the O(3) passive-basis special case of MR-CF4-ROT, with T=diag(P,1), including odd permutations when interpreted only as coordinate relabelling. Independently, a common observation-row permutation Q applied to N,p,v,w,sig_v leaves beta and every covariance unchanged.
exact_relations.decisive_falsifier: For coordinate axes, beta' != T beta or C' != T C T^T. For observation rows, any output drift. An odd coordinate permutation must not be mislabeled as the physical B-parity operation.
exact_relations.current_probe: PASS: an x-y swap gave coefficient residual 1.78e-15 and full-covariance residual 3.64e-12; a nontrivial row permutation gave coefficient residual 3.55e-15 and full-covariance residual 1.82e-11.

exact_relations.statement: With fixed geometry and covariance inputs, beta(lambda v)=lambda beta(v), ||B(lambda v)||=|lambda| ||B(v)||, and q(lambda v)=lambda^2 q(v) for q=B^T C_B^-1 B. For an injected template on baseline v0, delta_beta(lambda)=beta(v0+lambda X theta)-beta(v0)=lambda theta and q_delta(lambda)=lambda^2 theta^T C^-1 theta.
exact_relations.decisive_falsifier: Failure of coefficient linearity, covariance invariance, or squared-form lambda^2 scaling. Requiring beta, amplitude, Gaussian-equivalent sigma, or a total non-baseline-subtracted chi2 to scale as lambda^2 is itself an invalid metamorphic specification.
exact_relations.current_probe: PASS for lambda=2.5: coefficient residual 3.55e-15, covariance residual 0, and chi2 ratio 6.25.

exact_relations.statement: For full-rank X=[N,1], beta(v+c 1)=beta(v)+c e_M and the covariance is unchanged. More generally beta(v+N b+c 1)=beta(v)+(b,c). A pure monopole therefore changes only M in the augmented estimator even for incomplete sky coverage.
exact_relations.decisive_falsifier: Any bulk-flow change after adding c 1 to v in the augmented estimator, any monopole shift different from c, or silent point output for a rank-deficient augmented design. Leakage in the flow-only estimator is an expected negative control on an unbalanced sky, not a failure of this relation.
exact_relations.current_probe: PASS for c=50 km/s: augmented delta=(0,-3.55e-15,-8.88e-15,50.00000000000001). The flow-only negative control leaked (-2.2917,-1.8092,22.7517) km/s, showing why the intercept is required.

exact_relations.statement: The implemented cache is K_l(M,m)=1[M=m+2]-1[M=m-2], so K_l(-M,-m)=-K_l(M,m). With J reversing the five m channels and all scalar grids fixed, the current code exactly obeys P_B[J B]=-J P_B[B], P_B[-B]=-P_B[B], and P_B[B]_{l,0}=0. The transfer itself is linear in B_2; only a squared norm/power is quadratic in source amplitude.
exact_relations.decisive_falsifier: Any residual in those three implementation identities, survival of an even-sign mutation, or an output transfer claimed to scale quadratically rather than linearly. These identities do not constitute physical sky-parity validation.
exact_relations.current_probe: PASS only as implementation mechanics: m-reflection residual 0, source-sign residual 0, and m=0 output exactly 0 on a deterministic fixture.

exact_relations.statement: A genuine spatial-parity MR must be frozen in the selected spin-harmonic convention (conventionally a^B_lm transforms with the parity-odd factor (-1)^(l+1)) and must transform the full physical input state, not merely reverse the m array. The current source does not define enough structure to instantiate this relation.
exact_relations.decisive_falsifier: Failure of the frozen ell-dependent physical-parity law after a full-state transform. A pass of K(-M,-m)=-K(M,m), source sign reversal, B=0, or the zero-return helper cannot substitute for this test.
exact_relations.current_probe: BLOCKED/UNDERDEFINED: the implemented K has no ell-dependent parity phase, the arrays are forced real, and sigma_2M_history and photon_E_tower_history do not participate in the output.

dimensional_sign_limit_checks: CF4 WLS normalization is dimensionally consistent: dimensionless design times km/s response yields km/s coefficients and (km/s)^2 covariance; the quadratic form is dimensionless.

The rotation and permutation relations preserve the zero-flow, pure-monopole, local-basis, and isotropic-covariance limits. They do not validate the physical correctness of the fiducial velocity power spectrum or Gorski covariance.
At lambda=0 the coefficient relation gives zero, but a ratio-based quadratic test is undefined; use an absolute zero assertion.
The B kernel has the exact sign identity K(-M,-m)=-K(M,m), but this is an index reflection and not an externally authenticated spatial-parity convention.
The documented axisymmetric limit is not enforced at the projector boundary: sigma_2M_history is shape-checked and then unused, while the output is sourced solely from B_hist[:,2,m].

The B dimensional normalization is conditional on visibility having inverse-conformal-time units; source declarations do not validate the physical Wigner-D normalization or omitted coupling coefficients.
claim_tier_implications: A passing CF4 battery supports only exact estimator-equivariance and projection mechanics at C1.
A passing B index-oddness battery supports only the coded selection-rule mechanics at C1.
Neither pass validates the covariance model, B-mode physics, observations, transfer functions, matched nulls, cosmology, anisotropy, Bianchi geometry, or family identity.
The same estimator evaluated before and after a transform is one metamorphic oracle, not two independent physical validators.
fatal_blockers: The physical B-parity transformation is underdefined: no frozen harmonic basis, phase/reality rule, ell-dependent output law, or full-input transformation is present.

The projector's documented statement that axisymmetric sigma forces zero is false as an unconditional function contract. With only sigma_{2,0} nonzero and a nonzero accepted B_2,m=-2 source, the function emitted Delta_2,-2=-0.006921858926603516 and Delta_3,-2=-0.001042641428406513. Because sigma is unused, the function cannot enforce the stated premise.

Quadratic amplitude scaling must be attached to a squared norm/Mahalanobis statistic (or baseline-subtracted contrast), not to estimator coefficients, transfer amplitudes, Gaussian-equivalent sigma, or an arbitrary total statistic.
safe_claims: The named CF4 WLS estimator is equivariant under simultaneous passive rotations and coordinate-axis relabellings on the audited deterministic fixtures.
The flow-plus-monopole design algebraically prevents a constant radial monopole from leaking into the fitted bulk-flow coefficients when the design is full rank.
The implemented B kernel is odd under simultaneous M,m index reversal and linear under B-source sign/amplitude changes.
These are software/model self-consistency statements only.
required_tests_or_artifacts: Preregister O, T, exact transformed fields, condition-number policy, and absolute/relative tolerances for rotations; include at least one non-axis-aligned proper rotation.
Name coordinate-axis permutation and observation-row permutation separately; include an odd axis swap without calling it physical parity.
Preregister coefficient linearity, covariance invariance, amplitude |lambda| scaling, and squared-form lambda^2 scaling as distinct assertions; use baseline subtraction for additive injections.
Require the pure-monopole augmented-estimator relation and a deliberately unbalanced-sky flow-only leakage negative control; require rank deficiency to raise.
For B parity, either freeze and implement a genuine full-state spin-harmonic parity transform, or explicitly downscope the MR to K-index oddness. Do not count the latter as physical parity.

Resolve the axisymmetric-zero contract: either enforce consistency between sigma and B history at this boundary, test a complete upstream-generated state, or remove the claim that sigma alone forces projector zero. A B=0 fixture or the dedicated zero helper is too trivial to validate this premise.

Mutation falsifiers must kill at least: n-only rotation, omitted covariance conjugation, coefficient lambda^2 expectation, absent monopole intercept, parity plus-sign substitution, and a forged axisymmetric pass using the zero helper.

findings.title: Axisymmetric-zero projector invariant is not enforced
findings.detail: sigma_2M_history is validated but never read after validation. A legal-shape fixture with only sigma_{2,0} nonzero and B_2,m=-2=1 emitted nonzero ell=2 and ell=3 transfer. The documented invariant is therefore not a property of this callable unless an upstream B-history consistency premise is added and enforced.
findings.required_resolution: Repair or narrow the callable contract and use a nontrivial upstream-consistent negative control; fail PR-172 if the unconditional claim remains.

findings.title: Discrete index oddness is not yet a physical B-parity relation
findings.detail: The current kernel proves only K(-M,-m)=-K(M,m), source-sign linearity, and m=0 cancellation. The real-array convention, omitted ell-dependent parity phase, unused E/sigma inputs, and absent full-state transformation prevent a physical parity verdict.
findings.required_resolution: Freeze the complete spin-harmonic parity convention and transformation or label the test implementation-level index oddness only.

findings.title: Quadratic amplitude scaling must name the quadratic observable
findings.detail: Both coefficient/transfer surfaces are linear. Only a squared norm or fixed-covariance quadratic form scales as lambda^2. On a nonzero baseline, the quadratic relation applies to a baseline-subtracted contrast; otherwise cross terms are expected.
findings.required_resolution: Make the relation typed and exact before implementation.

findings.title: CF4 rotation, permutation, and monopole relations are sound under explicit premises
findings.detail: The WLS algebra and isotropic dot-product covariance support exact conjugation/equivariance, fixed-input linearity, and pure-monopole projection. Deterministic numerical probes agree to floating-point error.
findings.required_resolution: Preregister simultaneous field transforms, full-rank/conditioning policy, and invariant versus covariant outputs.
